about: Words that tell a street or a house number in the place of a fact ("Lhota, Dlouhá ulice 12"): the place is the municipality, the street and the number its house. Compared folded (no accents, lower case), word by word, in any script. words: a word of a street anywhere in a part; suffixes: a word ending so (German Hauptstraße, Dutch Kerkstraat); last: only as the last word of a part ("Main St." — "St. Martin" is a saint); house: what stands before a house number ("č. p. 12", "Nr. 3") — counted only with a number after it.
